sentences.text:
Nitesh Sharma And Ors 
 Through: Mr. Mitabh Gosain, 
 petitioners in per
 versus
 The State (Nct) Of Delhi And Anr 
 Through: Mr. Pradeep Gahal
 State with Si An
 Respondent No.2 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Or
% 18.05.2023
1.
This petition has been filed for seeking quashing of the FIR No.351/2018 registered under Sections 498A/406/354/509/34 IPC at PS Nihal Vihar, on the ground of a settlement between the parties.
The Memorandum of Settlement was arrived on 11.05.2023, which is on record of this Court.
As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.2 Lakh is to be paid at this stage.
2. The marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 has culminated into a divorce vide a decree dated 12.01.2023.
No child was born out of the said wedlock.
3. Petitioner No.1 to 5 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in the Court duly identified by the counsels and the IO.
As per the settlement, the balance amount of Rs.2 Lakhs has been tendered vide a DD bearing
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 14:58:01 No.727897 dated 08.05.2023 for Rs.2 Lakhs drawn on Punjab National Bank and has been received by respondent No.2, who has duly acknowledged the same.
4. Respondent No.2 states that she has filed an affidavit in this regard and that she has objection to the quashing of the said FIR.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.

Consequently, the FIR No.351/2018 registered under Sections 498A/406/354/509/34 IPC at PS Nihal Vihar, and proceedings emanating Nitesh Sharma And Ors vs The State (Nct) Of Delhi And Anr on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33958023/
1 therefrom are quashed.

6. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous.
7. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
